# Tokyo Cheapo

> > Tokyo Cheapo is a comprehensive budget travel and living guide for Tokyo, covering affordable food, shopping, entertainment, and practical tips for exploring Japan's capital without breaking the bank.

Founded as a resource for budget-conscious travelers and residents, Tokyo Cheapo provides insider knowledge on cheap eats, discount shopping, free events, and hidden gems across Tokyo's neighborhoods including Shibuya, Shinjuku, Harajuku, and Asakusa. The site features practical guides, venue reviews, and cultural insights to help visitors and expats experience Tokyo affordably.

## Key Topics

- Budget travel in Tokyo
- Cheap food and drinking spots
- Tokyo shopping districts (Shibuya, Shinjuku, Harajuku)
- Free and affordable events
- Import stores and foreign food
- Japanese culture (Yuru Kyara mascots, seasonal festivals)
- Tokyo neighborhoods and sightseeing
- Discount shopping and vintage clothing
- Craft beer and sake bars
- Tokyo cycling and outdoor activities
- Halloween and seasonal events
- Japanese cuisine (oden, izakaya)
- Record stores and music venues
- Museums and planetariums
- Expat living tips

## Essential Tokyo Guides

- [Beginner's Guide to Tokyo](https://tokyocheapo.com/living/beginners-guide-to-tokyo): Comprehensive beginner's guide to Tokyo with budget travel tips

## Food & Drink

- [Shinshu Osake Mura - Seriously Cheap](https://tokyocheapo.com/food-and-drink/drinking/shinshu-osake-mura-serious-beer-and-sake-seriously-cheap): Review of Shinshu Osake Mura sake bar in Shimbashi with craft beer
- [Discount Alcohol at Liquor Off](https://tokyocheapo.com/food-and-drink/drinking/discount-alcohol-liquor-get-drunk-without-breaking-bank): Guide to buying cheap alcohol at Liquor Off discount stores in Tokyo
- [Oden: Cheapo Comfort Food for Winter](https://tokyocheapo.com/food-and-drink/oden-comfort-food-winter): Guide to oden, traditional Japanese winter comfort food dish

## Shopping & Markets

- [Import Stores in Tokyo to Cure Your Back-Home Cravings](https://tokyocheapo.com/shopping-2/tokyo-import-stores): Guide to Tokyo import stores like National Azabu for foreign foods
- [Top 5 Cheap Shibuya Record Stores](https://tokyocheapo.com/shopping-2/shibuya-record-stores): Top 5 budget Shibuya record stores including Disk Union for vinyl
- [Don Don Down on Wednesday - Gambling for Cheap Clothes](https://tokyocheapo.com/shopping-2/forget-hm-and-uniqlo-heres-tokyos-stockpile-of-good-cheap-rags): Guide to vintage clothes shopping at Don Don Down in Harajuku & Koenji
- [Tokyo Artisan Alley - One-Of-A-Kind Japanese Craftsmanship](https://tokyocheapo.com/shopping-2/2k540-aki-oka-artisan): Profile of 2k540 Aki-Oka Artisan alley near Akihabara for crafts

## Sightseeing & Outdoor Activities

- [Tokyo Oases: Nature Nooks and Escapes in the City](https://tokyocheapo.com/entertainment/oases-tokyo-escape-city): Guide to Tokyo nature escapes like Atago Shrine & urban green spaces
- [Tokyo Cycling Routes: 5 Popular Paths to Explore the City](https://tokyocheapo.com/entertainment/sport/tokyo-cycling-routes): 5 scenic Tokyo cycling routes including Kanda River & Inokashira Park
- [Nezu Shrine: Seriously Underrated](https://tokyocheapo.com/entertainment/sightseeing/nezu-jinja-seriously-underrated): Review of underrated Nezu Shrine with torii gates & azalea festival
- [Stargazing at Cosmo Planetarium Shibuya: A Unique Afternoon in Tokyo](https://tokyocheapo.com/entertainment/museums-and-exhibitions/cosmo-planetarium-shibuya): Guide to visiting affordable Cosmo Planetarium Shibuya for stargazing
